description: List the valid filter names for a BrAPI endpoint (studies, germplasm, observations, variables, images, variants, locations) — companion lookup for the `extraFilters` passthrough on any `find_*` tool. Entries reflect the BrAPI v2.1 spec; individual servers may implement subsets.

endpoint.description: BrAPI endpoint to describe filters for.

name: brapi_describe_filters

availableEndpoints.description: Every endpoint this tool can describe — useful for discovery.

endpoint.description: The endpoint the filters apply to.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_endpoint`: No filter catalog is registered for the requested endpoint. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

filterCount.description: Number of filters in the catalog.

items.description: One filter entry — name, type, description, and an example value.

description.description: Short description of what the filter does.

name.description: Filter parameter name (as accepted by the BrAPI endpoint).

specReference.description: Pointer to the BrAPI v2 spec section for this endpoint.

title: Brapi Describe Filters
